title: Event Schema Evolution
description: Learn to evolve event schemas safely without breaking consumers in microservices.

data.text: Event schemas evolve over time as requirements change. LinkedIn, Netflix, and Uber all faced challenges when changing event schemas across hundreds of services. Proper schema evolution strategies prevent breaking changes and enable smooth migrations.
Events are immutable and may be consumed long after they are published. This means schema changes must be backward compatible. Adding fields is safe; removing or renaming fields is not.

data.title: Safe Schema Changes
items: Add metadata fields (correlation ID, trace ID)

data.title: Schema Registry
data.text: Use a schema registry like Confluent Schema Registry or Apicurio Registry. It validates schemas, manages versions, and prevents incompatible changes from being published.

data.title: Example: Safe Schema Evolution
data.code: Evolve an OrderCreated event by adding a new optional field.

data.caption: Schema evolution workflow
data.definition:
graph LR
    P[Producer] -->|Submit schema| SR[Schema Registry]
    SR -->|Validate| V{Compatible?}
    V -->|Yes| E[Event Published]
    V -->|No| R[Rejected]
    E --> C1[Consumer 1]
    E --> C2[Consumer 2]
    E --> C3[Consumer 3]

items.question: What is schema compatibility checking?
items.answer: Schema registries can check if a new schema is backward compatible with existing consumers. This prevents breaking changes from being published.

items.question: How do I handle old events with new schemas?
items.answer: Use upcasters to transform old events to the new schema when replaying. Keep transformation logic in a shared library.

items.question: What about Protobuf vs JSON Schema?
items.answer: Protobuf is more efficient and has better tooling for schema evolution. JSON Schema is more human-readable but has weaker evolution guarantees.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Events are immutable and must be schema compatible
Adding optional fields is safe; removing is not
Use schema registries to validate compatibility
Plan for schema evolution from the start
data.takeaway: Schema evolution is critical for long-lived event-driven systems; design schemas to evolve safely.
